description:
We want to invite a new Web/Application Developer to our design team. We’re very cool with those that are self-taught, but please provide examples/explanations of your work. Our current core integration supports Magento CE/EE; experience here is preferred. Communication, being a part of a team, and a willingness to learn tasks/responsibilities outside your own to understand our entire project processes and products are important. The more you know.
 This position is an integral part of a small, high performance team of web developers, designers, and integrators. We work hard in an environment that provides continuous challenges in taking our clients sites to the next level, day-to-day management (extension installation, code modification, data manipulation, etc.) of existing sites, as well as, launching new sites. 
 You will wear many “hats” and be responsible for setting up web servers for hosting websites, installations and configurations of various applications (including ecommerce), in addition to developing extensions and plugins to enhance internal and client requests. You will also assist in troubleshooting and support of these servers and systems, working on tickets alone or with the team, as needed. A typical setup environment will be Magento/LAMP, often including WordPress integration. 
 Many of these tasks are connected with larger integration projects, so being able to communicate with the project manager and clients on delivery, tasks, and risk expectations are critical. You will definitely be engaged in more than one project at a time, so being able to switch gears to allocate the right amount of time to each is valuable. 

 Job Specs: 
 - Competitive compensation (commensurate with experience)
 - Full-time; Benefits Medical, Vision, Dental, and paid vacations/holidays
 - Position is in Houston, TX; no telecommute options available
 - Monday – Friday; 9 AM – 6 PM; after-hours on-call as needed
 

 Typical Work Tasks: 
 - Maintain efficiency of existing Magento (and other) stores; plug-in updates, templates, etc.
 - Install, configure, and test 3rd-party Magento extensions
 - Develop custom Magento extensions based of internal or client specifications
 - Work with front end web designer to implement custom Magento templates
 - Diagnose and troubleshoot support issues
 - Maintain and implement the code of multiple WordPress sites
 - Work effectively within the Git version control environment
 - Effective sysadmin knowledge, as well as, work with sysadmin in managing code deployment throughout multiple environments (staging and production)
 


 Please provide a resume and examples of your work.
 
 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
